title: Draft finite clause grammar from PGP40129 selected fruit records

record_boundaries.PEACH: recto 5 through recto 13 immediately before אלרמֹאן
record_boundaries.POMEGRANATE: recto 13 at אלרמֹאן through verso 5 immediately before אלספרגֹל
record_boundaries.QUINCE: verso 5 at אלספרגֹל through verso 14 immediately before אלתֹפאחֹ

interpretive_policy.working_meanings: English meanings are source-translator working glosses where the public translation covers the clause; they describe the historical text and are not clinical claims.
interpretive_policy.surface_policy: Preserve exact Hebrew-script strings, combining marks, final forms, conjunction attachment, and source line breaks. No invented articles, restorations, transliteration, or normalization.
interpretive_policy.known_vs_generated: Every template below is observed_exact. This draft lists only three finite generated_novel recipes for the T04 follow-up alternatives; it emits no generated sentence. Any future slot substitution must be labeled generated_novel and must obey the compatibility bundles and single-head paragraph rule.
interpretive_policy.no_free_product: Do not take a fruit from one bundle, a condition from another, and an outcome from a third. A paragraph selects one head bundle and only its licensed templates.

PEACH.head: אלכוך
PEACH.secondary_comparison: T02 explicitly compares peach food with apricot food; this is a source-attested comparison dependency, not a free second-head substitution.

POMEGRANATE.head: אלרמֹאן
POMEGRANATE.condition_lock: T05/T06 are sour; T07 is sweet; T08 is the named soft-seed type; T09 is the cited woman case. Do not swap their outcomes.

QUINCE.head: אלספרגֹל
QUINCE.condition_lock: T10 keeps before/after-food branches; T11 is unripe; T12 is sour; T13 is sweet; T14 is a comparative degree continuation.

templates.source_context_line: אלכוך. בארד רטב מולד ללבלגם ואלגדא
templates.completeness: complete phrase; source sentence continues with further properties

templates.source_text_exact:
ואלגדא
אלמתולד מנה אגלטֹ מן אלגדא אלמתולד מן אלמשמש
וליס יפסד פי אלמעדה כפסאד אלמשמש.

dependencies.head: אלמתולד מנה refers back to peach

templates.working_meaning: The food produced from peach is thicker than food produced from apricot; it does not spoil in the stomach like apricot spoilage.
templates.completeness: complete comparison clauses; COMPARATOR is fixed by the source and cannot be freely replaced

templates.source_text_exact:
ומא כאן;
מן אלכוך רכו ינתזע מנה נואה בסהולה פהו אסרע
אנהצֹאמא ואנחדארא ען אלמעדה. ומא כאן מנה
מלתצקא בנואה וגֹוהרה צלב מנדמגֹ והו אלגֹבלי פהו
אגלטֹ ואבטא אנהצֹאמא.

dependencies.head: אלכוך explicit; מנה and נואה refer to the peach and its pit/part

templates.working_meaning: The source contrasts a soft peach whose pit is easily removed, with faster digestion and departure from the stomach, against a peach whose material adheres to the pit and is thicker and slower. The exact attachment of each predicate is an interpretive judgment.
templates.completeness: complete source clause sequence through the contrastive period

templates.source_text_exact:
ומתי אכלה אצחאב
אלמזאגֹ אלבארד פליאכלו בעדה זנגֹבילא מרבא או
עסל אלנחל או שראב אלעסל.

slots.HEAD: implicit peach
slots.FOLLOWUP: זנגֹבילא מרבא / עסל אלנחל / שראב אלעסל

templates.working_meaning: When people of cold temperament eat it, the source instructs them to eat ginger jam, bee honey, or honey drink after it.
templates.completeness: complete instruction; alternatives are an attested source list, not a free cross-product

templates.source_text_exact:
אלרמֹאן
בארד ומא כאן מנה חאמצֹא פהו קוי אלברד מעתדל
אלרטובה ואליבס קאמעא ללצפרא מקויא ללמעדה
ואלכבד אלחארתין מסכן ללקי.

dependencies.head: explicit pomegranate
dependencies.agreement: אלחארתין follows the coordinated stomach+liver phrase; source translation supports a dual-agreement working reading

templates.working_meaning: Pomegranate is cold; if sour, it is intensely cold, balanced in humidity and dryness, suppresses yellow bile, strengthens a hot stomach and liver, and alleviates vomiting.
templates.completeness: complete selected pomegranate clause through the period after ללקי

templates.source_text_exact:
וחב אלרמאן אלחאמץֹ
אדא גֹפף עקל אלטביעה ומנע אלמואד אלצפראויה
מן אלאנצבאב אלי אלבטן.

dependencies.head: explicit pomegranate seed
dependencies.lexical_caution: עקל אלטביעה is treated as a likely verb–object construction here, not idāfa

templates.working_meaning: The seed of sour pomegranate, if dried, constrains nature and prevents bilious substances from flowing into the abdomen.
templates.completeness: complete selected clause; source translation supplies the working historical meaning

templates.source_text_exact:
ואלרמאן אלחלוא מעתדל פי
אלחרארה ואלברודה והו רטב אלמזאגֹ.
templates.working_meaning: Sweet pomegranate is balanced in heat and cold and is moist in temperament.
templates.completeness: complete clause through the period after אלמזאגֹ

templates.source_text_exact:
ואלנוע אלמערוף
מנה באלמליסי אללין אלעגֹס ינפע מן אלסעל אלחאדא
מן חרארה והו מולד ללריאח פי אלמעדה אלבארדה

slots.HEAD: אלנוע אלמערוף מנה באלמליסי
slots.OUTCOME: ינפע מן אלסעל אלחאדא מן חרארה

dependencies.head: named pomegranate type introduced by אלנוע אלמערוף מנה

templates.working_meaning: The type known as Emlysian/Emilisi, with a soft seed, benefits acute cough from heat and generates wind in a cold stomach.
templates.completeness: complete selected clause through the end of recto 21

templates.source_text_exact:
ודכר בקראט פי כתאב אפידימיא אן אמראה כאן
יוגֹעהא פואדהא אעני פם מעדתהא וכאן יסכנה ענהא
מא אלרמאן מע סויק אלשעיר ודלך אן אלוגֹע כאן יערץֹ
להא מן מראר כאן ינצב אלי פם מעדתהא פכאן מא
אלרמאן יטפי דלך ואלסויק ינשפה.

dependencies.head: pomegranate is explicit in treatment and outcome
pronouns: פואדהא and מעדתהא = patient-linked body relation

templates.working_meaning: A cited case says a woman's mouth/stomach pain was treated with pomegranate water and barley drink; the source states that pomegranate water soothed the pain and the barley drink dried it.
templates.completeness: complete pomegranate case segment before the quince head; source attribution is preserved

templates.source_text_exact:

בארד יאבס קאבץֹ ללמעדה אלחארה עאקל ללטביעה
אדא אכל קבל אלטעאם. וילין אלטביעה אדא אכל בעד
אלטעאם וגדאוה כתיר.

dependencies.head: explicit quince
dependencies.lexical_caution: אלטביעה is the recipient's/nature term in the effect clause; do not treat it as a simple pronoun for quince

templates.working_meaning: Quince is cold, dry, and astringent for a hot stomach, constricting in nature if eaten before food; after food its nature softens and its nutrients are many.
templates.completeness: complete base and before/after-food clause sequence

source_offsets: verso:10 before ומא כאן מן אלספרגֹל
templates.source_text_exact:
ומא כאן מנה גיר נצֹיגֹ פהו עסר
אלאנהצֹאם בטי אלאנחדאר ען אלמעדה קוי אלחבס
ללטביעה.
templates.working_meaning: If quince is unripe, the source says it causes difficult digestion, slow emptying from the stomach, and strong constriction in nature.

templates.completeness: complete displayed clause segment, but English semantic coverage is incomplete in the public translation

required: Select exactly one bundle: PEACH, POMEGRANATE, or QUINCE.
Begin with an explicit head template when available; later pronouns must resolve to that head or to an explicitly introduced source argument.
Use only templates licensed by the selected bundle and preserve their condition/outcome pairing.
Keep each template's source record and line offsets; label copied source text observed_exact.
If a future output substitutes an attested slot, label it generated_novel and record the exact substitutions; do not present it as a historical quotation.
forbidden: Cross-fruit substitution or mixing peach, pomegranate, and quince conditions.
Invented articles, restored lacunae, dot/final normalization, or free feature cross-products.
Using the supplemental recto 2, verso 19/21, or right-margin material as selected-record clauses.
Clinical claims, Voynich symbol assignments, target fitting, reserve access, or decoder construction.
paragraph_contract.ceiling: This finite language is a source-grounded draft of clause dependencies and compatible bundles. It does not establish a Voynich language, code, translation, or historical medical truth.
